item.title: 80386 Multiplication and Division
item.description:
📝 Add-and-shift multiplication The classic multiplication algorithm in processors is the Booth algorithm. Instead, an "add-and-shift" multiplication algorithm is used. This is similar to grade-school long multiplication.

item.title: Telli (YC F24) is hiring eng, design, growth [on-site, Berlin]
"People are going to stop and ask you, 'How can I help?' Let them."
item.description:
📝 Connie Sherburne hide caption toggle caption Connie Sherburne In 2020, Connie Sherburne's husband of 31 years, Peter, died in a crash while piloting their small plane. "So many, many people did little things and big things to help me," Sherburne said. "So I just wanted to tell her how much that meant to me," Sherburne said.
🔗 Read more: https://www.npr.org/2026/01/20/nx-s1-5683170/let-them-the-small-bit-of-advice-that-made-a-big-difference-to-a-grieving-widow
